comparison.objective: Remove a loose hex key obstructing a cabinet track and open the guided glass door.
comparison.physical_skill: Obstruction retrieval, constrained sliding, bimanual handling, and avoidance of key loss or guide damage.
comparison.success_condition: Door opened about 288 mm with key retained in the work area and no apparatus/guide error; the available body does not expose the full numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: Obstruction clearance followed by prismatic opening is materially different from aligned hammer-and-mandrel fracture and recovery of four newly detached tangs.
